title: 처음 만난 사람과 나이 확인하기: 형? 언니? 선배?
objective: You can read short profiles and situations to find who is older and what people should call each other, and tell when it is polite to switch to casual speech.
summary: This worksheet shows how age and seniority shape the way Koreans talk to and address each other.
note: Customs about age and titles can be different for each person and workplace, so follow what the other person prefers.

task.title: Find, choose, and decide
task.line: Use the words and tips on page 1 to answer each question.

sections.heading: First meeting: how age sets the way you talk

steps.en: decide what to call each other
switch to casual speech, only if the older person suggests it

items.text: Koreans often compare age by birth year.
Same-age people often become friends quickly and use casual speech.
Use this instead of 나이 for an older person's age.
A man calls an older man 형. A woman calls an older man 오빠.
A man calls an older woman 누나. A woman calls an older woman 언니.
Someone who started school or work after you.
items.example: 제 후배가 이번에 우리 팀에 왔어요.

items.text: People who entered school or a company in the same year. Their ages can be different.
The youngest person in a family or group.
To start using casual speech with someone. The older person usually offers first.

sections.heading: Different from your country?
paragraphs: In many countries, asking someone's age feels too personal. In Korea, it is a normal question at a first meeting, because age decides your speech level and what you call each other.
At work, your job title matters more than your age. A younger manager is still 팀장님. Keep using 존댓말 with older people until they suggest 말 놓기.

exercises: Choose the right title: ① 도윤 씨(남자)가 한 살 많은 남자에게 (형 / 오빠) ② 하린 씨(여자)가 두 살 많은 여자에게 (언니 / 누나) ③ 태민 씨(남자)가 세 살 많은 여자에게 (언니 / 누나)
Fill in the blank with the polite word for age: 저희 할머니는 올해 ____가 여든이세요.
Choose the right word (선배 / 후배 / 동기): ① 저보다 1년 늦게 입학한 사람은 제 ____예요. ② 저와 같은 해에 입사한 사람은 제 ____예요.
Read the club list and answer in Korean: 수아 03년생, 준호 01년생, 민지 03년생, 현우 05년생. ① 수아 씨와 동갑인 사람은 누구예요? ② 이 동아리의 막내는 누구예요?
Is it polite? Write Yes or No: ① 38살 신입 사원이 34살 팀장을 '팀장님'이라고 불러요. ② 처음 만난 날, 나이가 어린 사람이 먼저 '우리 말 놓자.'라고 해요.
answers: ① 형 ② 언니 ③ 누나
① 민지 (민지 씨) ② 현우 (현우 씨)
